title: Naturality of homogeneous coefficient boundary projections
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion of schemes and L an O_X-module [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Fix n≥0 and write η_d:L^d→j_*j^*L^d for the tensor-pullback adjunction unit [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Assume each kernel sequence of η_d is short exact. Let T=(0→K→B→C→0) be any TensorGradedPresentation, with short-complex degree morphisms π_d and quotient components q_d=π_d,3 [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation]. Let D=(a_e,k_e) be any TensorBoundaryComparisonData [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]; D need not be identified with the canonical construction. Put A_e=H¹(Z,j^*(j.ker⊗L^n)⊗((j^*L)^n)^e) and let b_e:A_e≃H¹(X,ker η_(n(e+1))) be the additive equivalence induced by k_e [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Choose the derived categories needed for the canonical section boundaries [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-sc-module-cohomology-boundary, lem-sc-module-section-boundary-exact]. Take any injective resolutions of K,B,C and chain maps lifting the extension maps, whose sequence is degreewise short exact and whose global-sections image is short exact [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let δ′:Γ(X,C)→H¹(X,K) be its snake boundary, transported through the resolution/right-derived comparison isomorphisms and preceded by the canonical sections-to-zeroth-derived map. Define P_e=b_e^(-1)∘H¹(X,π_(n(e+1)),1), as in [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Then for every e≥0 and z∈Γ(X,C), P_e(δ′(z))=b_e^(-1)(∂_(η_(n(e+1)))(q_(n(e+1))(z))), where ∂ is the canonical section boundary. This is a single naturality diagram, asserting no multiplication or action identity.

proof.text: Unfold the explicit additive coefficient projection. Use tensorGradedUnit to name the original chosen adjunction unit and explicitly give the target of the coefficient additive equivalence; these are definitional abbreviations of the unchanged complete theorem type. Apply congruence for the inverse coefficient comparison and transport hboundary through the degree map. Apply resolvedBoundary_naturality directly to global sections, the short exact sequence supplied by T, and T.degree(n(e+1)), with the supplied compatible injective resolutions. Identify the quotient component by T.degree_quotient and the target canonical boundary by unfolding moduleSectionBoundary and moduleCohomologyBoundary. No product or action identity is used.

theorem tensorGradedProjection_boundary {X Z : Scheme.{u}} {j : Z ⟶ X}
    [IsClosedImmersion j]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))]
    {L : X.Modules} {n : ℕ} (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L)
    (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hshort : ∀ d : ℕ, (ShortComplex.kernelSequence
      (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d))).ShortExact)
    (IA : InjectiveResolution T.I)
    (IB : InjectiveResolution (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf T.B))
    (IC : InjectiveResolution (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf T.C))
    (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map T.i ≫ IB.ι)
    (hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map
      (tensorGradedAlgebraMap T.p) ≫ IC.ι)
    (hH : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
    (hΓ : ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ))).ShortExact)
    (δ' : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj T.I))
    (hboundary : ∀ z : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤), δ' z =
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
          (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf T.C) ≫
        (IC.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) 0).hom ≫
        hΓ.δ 0 1 rfl ≫
        (IA.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) 1).inv).hom z))
    (e : ℕ) (z : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :
    tensorGradedCoefficientProjection T D e (δ' z) =
      (Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
        (Y := AddCommGrpCat.of ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))))) (D.k e)).symm
        (RingedSpace.moduleSectionBoundary X.toRingedSpace
          (ShortComplex.kernelSequence
            (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) (hshort (n * (e + 1)))
          (Hom.app (T.q (n * (e + 1))) ⊤ z))
